Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing of entire proceedings, including charge-sheet dated 12.05.2017 and cognizance/summoning order dated 22.07.2017, of Case No.
1420 of 2017 (State Vs. Imran and others), arising out of case crime no. 142 of 2016, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S.- Mahila Thana, District- Agra, pending in the court of Civil Judge (J.D.)/F.T.C Ist Agra.

sentences.text: It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that the matter relates to matrimonial dispute and that earlier the applicants have filed an application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. No.32912 of 2019 for quashing of impugned proceedings of the case, on the basis of compromise.

The said application was decided by this Court vide order dated 11.09.2019 and applicants were directed to file the compromise application before the trial Court concerned and it was directed that till the verification of compromise, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.
Learned counsel submitted that in pursuance to the said order, parties could not file compromise before the trial Court under the misconception that the case has already been closed.
It was submitted that now warrants are being issued by the trial Court.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the application.

5. I have considered the rival submissions and perused the record.
6.

It is apparent from record that applicants have earlier filed an application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. No.32912 of 2019 for quashing of proceedings on the basis of compromise between the parties, which was decided by this Court vide order dated 11.09.2019 and parties were directed to file compromise application before the trial Court.
It was stated that applicants have not filed any such application for compromise before the trial Court.
This second application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed after five years of the same, seeking same prayer.
Keeping in view the facts of the matter and conduct of applicants, no case for quashing of proceedings is made out.
Hence, the prayer sought by applicants is refused.

7. However considering the facts of the matter, it is directed that in case, applicants appear/surrender before the court concerned within a period of three weeks from today and apply for bail, their bail application shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with settled law 8.
The instant application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of accordingly.

Order Date :- 10.9.2024 SP/-
